name: UNESCO Education for Inclusion Policy
description: Policy framework aligned with UNESCO's Salamanca Statement and Framework for Action on Special Needs Education, and the 2030 Education Agenda (SDG 4), focusing on inclusive, equitable quality education for all.
key_sections: Scope: Groups with Special Educational Needs
Curriculum Adaptation and Universal Design for Learning
Transition Pathways (school to higher education / employment)
key_requirements: Alignment with Salamanca Statement (1994) or 2030 Education Agenda
Explicit definition of inclusive education vs. integration/segregation
Coverage of disability, language minorities, migrants, Roma and other excluded groups
Curriculum adaptation or Universal Design for Learning (UDL) approach
Data collection and disaggregated enrolment statistics
Clear responsible authority and coordination mechanism
